header.name: Dispatch Functions
header.description: System flow to load and unload distribution groups to and from workcenters

data.transform:
{
  "SUCCESS":false,
  "MESSAGE": (
    $wc := $.workOrderProcessDistributionGroup.edges.node.workcenter;
    $curr := $count($.workOrderProcessDistributionGroup.edges.node.workcenter.productionSetup.outputs.edges);
    $dist := $count($.workOrderProcessDistributionGroup.edges.node.distributions.edges);


    "Cannot dispatch "
      &
    $dist
      &
    " distributions to Workcenter "
      &
    $wc.code
      &
    ($curr>0 ? " (" & $curr & " current outputs) " : " " )
      &
    "with a maximum concurrency of "
      &
    $wc.concurrency

  )
  
}
